items.problem: The bootstrap omitted source files and assets linked from outside the project directory.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 181-208 copied only 8 local files; lines 2402-3391 show manual discovery of SharedContent. The source csproj links App.xaml, MainPage, Styles.xaml, and assets through Link metadata.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, SharedContent, Compile Include, and external; no support was found.
items.root_cause: The script inventories with Get-ChildItem -Recurse under -Source rather than evaluated project items.
items.proposed_fix: Evaluate external linked project items with Visual Studio MSBuild and copy safe source/XAML/resource/asset inputs to their Link destinations before mapping.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP SDK samples and shared-code solutions commonly use linked files outside each project folder.

items.problem: The skill instructs agents to run a nonexistent winapp build command and thereby creates an incompatible launch-output path when they fall back to plain dotnet build.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3611-3672 show winapp build rejected; lines 4424-4427 show Test-AppLaunch could not find bin\x64\Debug.
items.skill_search: winapp build appears in SKILL.md lines 126, 138, and 170 and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md line 667.
items.root_cause: The prose predates the current CLI and does not match the validator/launcher platform layout.
items.proposed_fix: Replace build instructions with native dotnet build using Debug and an explicit current-architecture Platform.
items.generalizes: Every migration uses the same build/launch loop and current winapp CLI surface.

items.problem: The NavigationView shell pattern lacks concrete visual-fidelity rules, producing a light theme, extra Settings item, wider pane, desktop title-bar drift, and wrapped headings.
items.evidence: discrepancies.json entries 1-3 and migration-score.json: all three features partial due to theme and shell differences; Conversion and ReverseConversion headings wrapped.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for IsSettingsVisible, OpenPaneLength, RequestedTheme, title bar, and wrapping; no shell-fidelity checklist was found.
items.root_cause: The replacement pattern specifies navigation event wiring but leaves new-control defaults and window chrome unchecked.
items.proposed_fix: Add a source-derived shell-fidelity checklist to the existing NavigationView pattern: theme, Settings visibility, pane width/display mode, title-bar strategy, and text wrapping/min-width.
items.generalizes: Replacing UWP SplitView/ListView shells with NavigationView introduces the same WinUI defaults in many SDK-sample migrations.

items.problem: The x:Bind section omits WMC0503 and does not state that markup extensions cannot be authored as object elements.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 4122-4146 show WMC0503; lines 4165-4189 show the invalid property-element binding and fix.
items.skill_search: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md x:Bind section only covers stale namespace type errors.
items.root_cause: The guidance says x:Bind has the same syntax but gives no diagnostic recipe for invalid property-element form.
items.proposed_fix: Add WMC0503 guidance with valid attribute syntax and code-assignment fallback.
items.generalizes: Compiled bindings are common in migrated UWP XAML and WMC0503 is otherwise terse.
